title: Defeat the Gatekeeper
description: A boss-monster guards the lower floor. Defeat it to proceed deeper into the dungeon.
story: The lower floor awaits, but standing between you and the depths of the dungeon is the Gatekeeper — a grotesque amalgamation of muscle, shadow, and malice. Its eyes burn with an intelligence that suggests it is no mere beast. The creature wears the remnants of fallen hunters like trophies, armor fused to its corrupted flesh. As you step into the chamber, the heavy stone doors seal behind you. There is no turning back. The air grows cold, and the torchlight flickers as the Gatekeeper lets out a roar that shakes the very foundation of the dungeon. You feel the System pulsing in your vision, analyzing, calculating. 'Defeat the Gatekeeper to proceed.' The message is simple, but the execution will be anything but. Every swing of its massive cleaver arm carves grooves into the stone floor. You dodge, you weave, and you fight not just for glory, but for survival. This is the moment that separates the E-Rank hunters from those who will rise. Will you fall like the others whose bones litter this chamber, or will you emerge victorious and claim the rare artifact that the Gatekeeper guards? The System watches. The dungeon waits. Your fate is in your hands.
